title: Rectangle Overlap
statement: Each rectangle is given as [x1, y1, x2, y2] with (x1, y1) the bottom-left corner and (x2, y2) the top-right. Return whether the two overlap in a region of positive area. Touching along an edge or at a corner is not an overlap.
constraints: each rectangle has x1 < x2 and y1 < y2
hints: Enumerating the ways two rectangles can overlap gives a long, bug-prone case analysis. Look for the shorter question instead.
The x extents are just two intervals, and so are the y extents. Overlap in 2D happens exactly when both pairs of intervals overlap.
Two intervals [a1,a2] and [b1,b2] overlap with positive length when max(a1,b1) < min(a2,b2). Apply it twice and combine with AND.
